title: Calm Barrier Cream
---

Calm Barrier Cream is a Serein Studio product. Its formula is really rich and it helps to reduce redness in 4 weeks. This cream is for all skin types. Apply a pea-sized amount each night on a clean face. It leaves the skin light and the cream is fragrance-free.
